page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.8xlarge is a general-purpose server instance built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. It provides 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores via hyperthreading on a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor. The processor integrates 48 MB of L3 cache alongside 48 KB of L1 data cache and 1 MB of L2 cache per core. Instruction set extensions include AVX-512 with Vector Neural Network Instructions (VNNI), AES, VAES, and SHA-NI, which support accelerated vector operations and cryptographic tasks.

The instance is equipped with 128 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4 GB per virtual core. Local storage is not bundled, making the instance entirely dependent on external cloud block storage for persistent filesystem operations. Networking is provisioned with a 16 Gbps baseline throughput. Public IPv4 addresses are not included complimentary, requiring dedicated IP allocation when external connectivity is required.

Benchmark assessments place the ecs.g7t.8xlarge predominantly within the median range of comparable hardware profiles. It achieved a multi-core stress-ng rating of 31066.84 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 13733.0, with single-core results registering at 1881.88 and 1605.0 respectively. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth reached 153.13 GB/sec, accompanied by 68.53 GB/sec in uncached write throughput. In application-focused evaluations, the system sustained 31.19 million Redis SET operations per second and 33.09 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. For lightweight machine learning inference, text generation on a 135M parameter model ranked in the top quartile at 305.55 tokens per second, while a medium 7B model ran at 18.27 tokens per second.

Without local NVMe storage or dedicated GPU silicon, the ecs.g7t.8xlarge focuses strictly on central processing throughput and memory bandwidth. The balanced resource density makes it appropriate for enterprise application servers, container orchestration nodes, in-memory data caches, CI/CD build environments, and web serving fleets.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.8xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance providing 32 dedicated vCPUs and 16 physical cores powered by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor. Configured with a 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio, the system includes 128 GB of RAM and 48 MB of L3 cache, backed by vector and cryptographic extensions including AVX-512 and VNNI. The instance features a 16 Gbps baseline network interface but does not include bundled local storage, requiring attached network volumes for persistent storage. Benchmark testing shows steady, middle-tier results across standard compute and memory metrics, highlighted by 31.19 million Redis SET operations per second, a PassMark CPU score of 36670.06, and 33.09 GB/s static web serving throughput. Small-scale model inference achieves 305.55 tokens per second for text generation. The configuration provides balanced resource density suited for multi-threaded enterprise services, middle-tier application servers, caching platforms, and structured data processing pipelines.
